excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Both pivotal Phase 3 trials terminated in March 2025 after failing to meet primary endpoint of superiority over standard-of-care anti-VEGF monotherapy. Opthea announced discontinuation of the entire wet AMD development program for sozinibercept; no other clinical assets remain. Trading suspended on ASX; going-concern uncertainty disclosed.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Opthea's only clinical asset, sozinibercept (OPT-302), failed both pivotal Phase 3 nAMD trials (ShORe and COAST) in March 2025 and the program was terminated. The company has no remaining active P1/P2/P3 programs and faces material going-concern uncertainty.
